scripts.verify: vp run build && vp test && vp check
scripts.deploy: vp -C server exec sh -c 'if [ -f .env.local ]; then cf deploy --secrets-file .env.local; else cf deploy; fi'
scripts.deploy:dry: vp -C server exec sh -c 'if [ -f .env.local ]; then cf deploy --dry-run --secrets-file .env.local; else cf deploy --dry-run; fi'
